-- =====================================================
-- GOLD ECONOMIC REFRESH
-- Source: lh_nyc_taxi (Silver)
-- Target: wh_nyc_taxi_analytics (Gold)
-- Tables: DimGDP, DimFX
-- =====================================================

SET NOCOUNT ON;

-- 1. Validate duplicate keys in Silver and Gold

IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lh_nyc_taxi.dbo.silver_worldbank_gdp
    GROUP BY country_code, year
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
    THROW 50001, 'Duplicate GDP source keys', 1;

IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lh_nyc_taxi.dbo.silver_ecb_fx_rates
    GROUP BY date, currency
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
    THROW 50002, 'Duplicate FX source keys', 1;

IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.DimGDP
    GROUP BY country_code, year
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
    THROW 50003, 'Duplicate GDP target keys', 1;

IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.DimFX
    GROUP BY fx_date, currency
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
    THROW 50004, 'Duplicate FX target keys', 1;


-- 2. Refresh DimGDP

MERGE dbo.DimGDP AS target
USING (
    SELECT
        country_code,
        year,
        gdp_usd
    FROM lh_nyc_taxi.dbo.silver_worldbank_gdp
    WHERE country_code IS NOT NULL
      AND year IS NOT NULL
) AS source

ON target.country_code = source.country_code
AND target.year = source.year

WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        target.gdp_usd = source.gdp_usd

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (
        country_code,
        year,
        gdp_usd
    )
    VALUES (
        source.country_code,
        source.year,
        source.gdp_usd
    );


-- 3. Refresh DimFX

MERGE dbo.DimFX AS target
USING (
    SELECT
        date AS fx_date,
        currency,
        usd_per_eur
    FROM lh_nyc_taxi.dbo.silver_ecb_fx_rates
    WHERE date IS NOT NULL
      AND currency IS NOT NULL
) AS source

ON target.fx_date = source.fx_date
AND target.currency = source.currency

WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        target.usd_per_eur = source.usd_per_eur

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (
        fx_date,
        currency,
        usd_per_eur
    )
    VALUES (
        source.fx_date,
        source.currency,
        source.usd_per_eur
    );

-- Refresh FactTaxiDaily
-- Synchronize daily Taxi metrics from Silver to Gold.

MERGE dbo.FactTaxiDaily AS target
USING (
    SELECT
        trip_date,
        pickup_location_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
        SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue_usd,
        AVG(fare_amount) AS avg_fare_usd,
        AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_trip_distance
    FROM lh_nyc_taxi.dbo.silver_yellow_taxi_trips
    WHERE trip_date IS NOT NULL
      AND pickup_location_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        trip_date,
        pickup_location_id
) AS source
ON target.trip_date = source.trip_date
AND target.pickup_location_id = source.pickup_location_id

WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        target.total_trips = source.total_trips,
        target.total_revenue_usd = source.total_revenue_usd,
        target.avg_fare_usd = source.avg_fare_usd,
        target.avg_trip_distance = source.avg_trip_distance

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (
        trip_date,
        pickup_location_id,
        total_trips,
        total_revenue_usd,
        avg_fare_usd,
        avg_trip_distance
    )
    VALUES (
        source.trip_date,
        source.pickup_location_id,
        source.total_trips,
        source.total_revenue_usd,
        source.avg_fare_usd,
        source.avg_trip_distance
    );

-- 1. Refresh DimDate
-- Add missing dates through the end of the current year + 4 years

MERGE dbo.DimDate AS target
USING (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(
            DAY,
            value,
            CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        ) AS full_date
    FROM GENERATE_SERIES(
        0,
        DATEDIFF(
            DAY,
            CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE),
            DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 4, 12, 31)
        )
    )
) AS source
ON target.full_date = source.full_date

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (
        full_date,
        year,
        month,
        day
    )
    VALUES (
        source.full_date,
        YEAR(source.full_date),
        MONTH(source.full_date),
        DAY(source.full_date)
    );


-- 2. Refresh DimZone
-- Synchronize Taxi zones from Silver to Gold

MERGE dbo.DimZone AS target
USING (
    SELECT
        location_id,
        borough,
        zone_name,
        service_zone
    FROM lh_nyc_taxi.dbo.silver_taxi_zones
    WHERE location_id IS NOT NULL
) AS source
ON target.location_id = source.location_id

WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        target.borough = source.borough,
        target.zone_name = source.zone_name,
        target.service_zone = source.service_zone

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (
        location_id,
        borough,
        zone_name,
        service_zone
    )
    VALUES (
        source.location_id,
        source.borough,
        source.zone_name,
        source.service_zone
    );
